items.title: Your next customer could be an AI: Why digital identity is heading for a reset
items.summary: As autonomous AI systems begin shopping, booking and making decisions for people, the familiar concept of digital identity may need to change. By 2027, organisations could increasingly face a new question: is the entity requesting access a person, a machine, or a machine legitimately acting for a person?
items.interpretation: 这里的关键不只是技术展示，而是硬件落地能力和供应链执行力——这往往决定一项技术是否能真正形成护城河。
